method.metric_formula: For complete 40-image rankings: Hit@k is any positive in first k; Recall@k divides first-k positives by all qrel positives; MRR is reciprocal first-positive rank; AP averages precision at every positive rank over all positives. Every rejected intent contributes zero to every unconditional metric; aggregate denominator is16. Accepted-only average excludes failed intents and reports its own denominator.
method.percentile_formula: Sorted samples with linear interpolation at (n-1)*q, q=0.5/0.95; mean from math.fsum/n; includes all successes and failures. No benchmark metric/stats/compare helper was imported.

Local tokenizers/processors loaded only to decode saved tokens, re-encode target constraints and recompute processor identity.

representative_source_and_rationale_asse.assessment: The Chinese asks above-body bare copper and connected right-side cable. On-body versus above-body and cable proximity versus attachment are separately graded. Casing closure is correctly not applicable.

No wires were removed does not assert no outgoing wires. Omitted absence credit is appropriate; explicit micro-solar inverter partial credit is transparently narrower than frozen microinverter wording.

The Chinese asks mounting on a metal bracket below the panel back, with a post beside it. Staircase weakens support type without making the post the mounting support; spatial and support checks remain separate.
Fuse replaces wire in all outputs. Constrained Bushing is a detached tail, so token/word coverage does not warrant clear term-in-context or complete translation credit.

The source requests nonvisible fins and upper bushing/wiring. Broad radiator credit is partial; constrained with-radiators/incoherence contradicts or loses the source despite the forced bushing token.

Source cables hang in front of fins; original/constrained reverse the front relation, while ordinary beam retains cables in front and still loses hanging. The differing relation judgments are justified.

The source counts two louvered doors on one transformer box; original/beam count boxes instead. Shutters is a defensible but disclosed interpretation of louvered doors. No extra casing-closure check is added.
Chinese lower/below-cabinet wording remains physically ambiguous. Literal under the cabinet is retained for grading; no inside-bay demand is invented.

limitations_and_ledger_notes: The audit independently recalculates metrics and latency summaries from stored rankings/timings. It does not re-run translation or retrieval or prove score generation from neural weights.

Per-repeat warm samples store timings, status and error, but not repeat-specific English, traces, ranks or scores. Stored zero rank-disagreement/max-score-drift assertions and cross-model frozen representative outputs are checked; individual repeated ranks/traces cannot be independently replay-audited from these saved samples.

Actual total_ms is independently measured by the runner. This audit checks nonnegative finite values, stage containment and percentiles, but cannot reconstruct historical wall-clock timestamps from duration-only samples.

Gallery is the same 40 images used historically; 16 new compositional language intents are not independent field-image observations. Labels and blind text review are assistant-only and not independent human or electrical-engineering truth.

Review identities are anonymized but six capped repetitive outputs and surface vocabulary can suggest the decoder. Key-access and retrieval-exclusion claims are declarations plus file/hash evidence, not independently observable historical access controls.

The 56 context checks per decoder overlap across categories and are not independent statistical samples or a weighted whole-sentence score. Accepted-only subsets change the intent/term denominators and cannot establish an unconditional quality improvement.

Several source/lexical decisions remain interpretive: t16 below-cabinet wording, radiant fin partial credit, micro-solar inverter partial credit, generic connections specificity, and shutters as louvered doors. Representative rationale was assessed for source applicability, without revising frozen queries, labels, rules or grades.

Retrieval weight bytes are rehashed now at immutable model-revision cache paths, and model/config/processor/index identities bind the run. Frozen protocol does not separately list retrieval-weight-byte hashes; this is not a historical byte-for-byte measurement of model memory.
